final: SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(ram.riskandmarginpivot) as risk_margin_count, COUNT(ram.riskandmarginpivot) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM riskandmargin ram2 JOIN orders o2 ON ram2.ordervault = o2.recordvault) as share, COUNT(ram.riskandmarginpivot) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM riskandmargin ram2 JOIN orders o2 ON ram2.ordervault = o2.recordvault) - 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o3.timespan) FROM riskandmargin ram3 JOIN orders o3 ON ram3.ordervault = o3.recordvault) as deviation_from_average FROM riskandmargin ram JOIN orders o ON ram.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan ORDER BY o.timespan
